pages.text: Put a lava bucket and a vanilla glass bottle in the grid to pour 125 mB of lava. Retrieve the leftover 875 mB of lava. Craft the lava glass with a water bucket to quench it into an obsidian bottle.
Craft the obsidian bottle on its own into one obsidian dust. Nine dust pieces compact back into obsidian. The quench uses the glass bottle and returns the empty water bucket.

Craft one obsidian dust, a lava bucket and an empty syringe for a filled bath-salts syringe. The powder can also be used on its own. See $(l:psychedelicraft:effects/bath_salts)its in-game effects$(/l).
